name: Baron Aquanis
summary: Beneath Ashenvale, Baron Aquanis leaves a strange globe filled with tainted fluid. Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring believes it may show what corrupted the elemental, and suspects the Twilight's Hammer cultists in the submerged ruins.

sections.title: A Corrupted Heart
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps holds Baron Aquanis, a water spirit twisted by foul sorcery. When the elemental is destroyed, a Strange Water Globe remains behind. The impervious orb holds putrid fluid that seems to have sustained and warped Aquanis's natural essence. Physical force cannot harm it, and its energies unsettle those attuned to the balance of the elements.

sections.title: Studies of the Earthen Ring
sections.body: Je'neu Sancrea serves the Earthen Ring from a camp on the Zoram Strand. He recognizes the Strange Water Globe as evidence of unnatural meddling. The order suspects that dark forces corrupted Baron Aquanis, and Je'neu suspects the Twilight's Hammer cultists in the sunken temple. He studies the globe to test that suspicion and learn how the cultists subdue and twist Azeroth's elemental spirits.

faq.answer: Baron Aquanis is a powerful water elemental in the underground waters of Blackfathom Deeps. Dark practitioners in the ruined temple have corrupted and bound the elemental.

faq.q: What is the Strange Water Globe?
faq.answer: The Strange Water Globe is an impervious sphere left behind when Baron Aquanis is defeated. Putrid liquid sloshes inside, carrying the tainted energy that fueled the elemental's corrupted state.

faq.q: Why does Je'neu Sancrea want the globe?
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea studies the globe to learn whether the Twilight's Hammer caused the corruption and to uncover the rites used to twist elemental spirits. As a member of the Earthen Ring, he watches for elemental disturbances across Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who is behind the corruption of Baron Aquanis?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cultists deep inside Blackfathom Deeps are the chief suspects. Their presence in the temple fits a pattern of desecration and dark communion with unnatural beings.

aliases: where to turn in water globe
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea is an Earthen Ring shaman camped along the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwestern coast, near the entrance to the Blackfathom Deeps caverns.

faq.q: What follows the turn-in of this quest?
faq.answer: Handing over the globe leads to more inquiries into the region's elemental distress. Adventurers continue helping the Earthen Ring oppose the growing blight.

angles.text: As a shaman, you know the Earthen Ring sees corruption of elemental spirits as a grave violation of the natural order. Investigating Baron Aquanis's tainted state is central to restoring elemental balance.
As a member of the Horde, you can join Je'neu Sancrea's work with Horde scouts at the Zoram'gar Outpost. They seek champions to cleanse the corrupted waters beneath Ashenvale's coast.
